value: Close the credibility gap: every visible link must lead somewhere real
Footer/nav promise nine routes (FAQs, Warranty, Shipping, Installation Guides, Quote, Terms, Privacy, Sitemap, Account) that do not exist in Pages/. Fix per docs/roadmap/GOALS.md G1.
planned
Make discovery-to-purchase actually work end to end
Search is inert in two places (header SearchBox -> /search 404s; Products page ExploreProductRange binding never fires). Checkout return page shows no order details.
planned
Give industrial buyers the pre-sale and post-sale content they need

Buyers of nanobubble systems need specs, install requirements, warranty terms, shipping/lead-time info, and often a custom quote rather than self-serve checkout. Contact form has a literal TODO and discards every submission.
planned
Resolve brand inconsistency and reach genuine production readiness

App title/tagline says Oxyniti - Natural Innovation but About page body copy describes the company as Revaron. Most pages have no PageTitle or meta description. Stripe key is pk_test - the site cannot take a real payment today. No password-reset flow.
planned

MainLayout.razor GoToMakerAIAsync already bridges IsMakerAIUser accounts via SSO into the Maker AI MES/ops platform - a real, differentiated growth lever currently invisible to anyone not already logged in as a recognized Maker AI user.
